description: Fresh raw-only df.parquet + causal feature ffill rerun of e2000fs_calib11h_noenlil. Input features and TRAINING y causally forward filled; official evaluation truth unchanged. Model architecture and seed preserved; current F1/F2/F3 144-hour maturity masks. Full training completed; no evaluation-target calibration or selection. Baseline submission: 20261102T075958881Z. Existing results retained.

data.prefill: ffill by h over sorted origin, train/query union; identical duplicate inputs required; leading NaNs retained; targets and metadata unchanged; training y ffill on sorted target_time; query y unchanged
data.target: training y ffill by target_time; official query truth unchanged

booster.rounds_selection: inherited from the parent (rolling-origin argmin on the quarter ending immediately before each period's training cutoff)

objective.estimand: E[w(Y)Y|x]/E[w(Y)|x] = probability-weighted mixture of conditional tail means
objective.family: SERA relevance-weighted squared error (per-row, per-lead weights), identical to the parent
objective.rho_source: none; the SERA weights need no calibration block and no fitted scalar
objective.weights: w_i = (y_i - q0)/(q100 - q0) per lead, median-anchored; labels only

original_recipe.post_processing: none (no clipping, no calibration lane, no blend)
